title: Emrys and the Asset
author: Zephyrine Pemberton
blurb: Emrys Voss, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
